_note: ຄັງສຽງທີ່ Joe ຈັດອັນດັບເອງ (18 ພະຈິກ 2026). ຖາມເລືອກສະເພາະ 5 ສຽງນີ້. model = ໂມເດລທີ່ສ້າງຕົວຢ່າງທີ່ Joe ຟັງ.

voices.character: ໂຄ້ດບອລ — ວິເຄາະແທັກຕິກ
voices.use: ວິເຄາະເກມ, ແທັກຕິກ, ຈຸດປ່ຽນ, ຂ່າວຈິງຈັງ
voices.style: Ultra-clear, energized Lao football tactician. Fast continuous analytical pacing with crisp micro-breaths on tactical transitions, keeping match breakdowns thrilling and sharp.

voices.character: ອ້າຍບ່າວຂ້າງບ້ານ — ພາກສາຍຮາ
voices.use: ຄລິບຕະຫຼົກ, ແຊວບານ, ປຽບທຽບຊີວິດຄົນລາວ
voices.style: Witty, clear, fast-talking Lao football banter creator. Rapid continuous comedic pacing with lively quick breath beats right before punchlines, energetic fan excitement.

voices.character: ຈັນທີ — ແຟນບານເຊຍສົດ
voices.use: ຣີແອັກຫຼັງເກມ, ອ່ານຄອມເມັ້ນ, ຊວນແຟນໃຫ້ຄະແນນ
voices.style: Warm, spirited, expressive young Lao female football fan-zone host. Lively post-match conversational pace with genuine laughs, excited sighs, and relatable fan reactions.

voices.character: ຟ້າໃສ — ປຸກກະແສກ່ອນເກມ
voices.use: ກ່ອນເກມ, ລາຍຊື່ຕົວຈິງ, ນັບຖອຍຫຼັງ, ຊວນທາຍຜົນ
voices.style: Crisp, thrilled young Lao female football presenter. Fast continuous pre-match hype with snappy quick breath catches between starting-XI surprises and derby stakes.

voices.character: ມັງກອນທະລຸຕາຂ່າຍ — ລະເບີດສຽງຍິງປະຕູ
voices.use: ຄລິບປະຕູ, ຍິງໄກ, ປະຕູຊະນະນາທີສຸດທ້າຍ
voices.style: Explosive, chest-pounding Lao male goal commentator. Builds fierce rising tension through the buildup and detonates with thrilling, adrenaline-soaked triumph on thunderbolt goals.
